lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: the effect of dilation on lines through and off the center
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: the effect of dilation on lines through and off the center

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of equal angles. Similar?

steps: The third angles must match too.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that passes through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped to a parallel line a fixed distance away
is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped to a line through the origin with a different slope

items.prompt: Dilate the point (5, 5) about the origin with scale factor 5. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 5 becomes a side of length 10. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 2; the area is multiplied by 2
scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 4
scale factor 1/2; the area is multiplied by 4
scale factor 2; the area is multiplied by 4

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 78° and ∠B = 40°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 78° and ∠E = 40°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that does not pass through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped to a line with slope multiplied by the scale factor
is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped to a parallel line

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: Dilate the point (-5, -2) about the origin with scale factor 3. Give the image.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A figure is dilated so that a side of length 19 becomes a side of length 95. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 31° and ∠B = 27°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 31° and ∠E = 27°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
